description: Header file defining the FileEnumerator class for directory and file enumeration, including nested FileInfo class, enums for file types and folder search policies, and platform-specific implementations.

classes.name: FileEnumerator
classes.description: Class for enumerating files and directories within a specified path, supporting recursive search, pattern matching, and platform-specific file info retrieval.

classes.name: FileInfo
classes.description: Nested class representing information about a file or directory, including name, size, last modified time, and platform-specific data.

methods.name: FileEnumerator
methods.description: Constructs a FileEnumerator with specified root path, recursion, file type, pattern, and folder search policy.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Returns the next file path in the enumeration, or an empty path if no more files.

methods.name: GetInfo
methods.description: Retrieves information about the current file in the enumeration.

methods.name: ShouldSkip
methods.description: Determines if a given path should be skipped during enumeration.

methods.name: IsTypeMatched
methods.description: Checks if a file or directory matches the specified type filter.

methods.name: IsPatternMatched
methods.description: Checks if a file path matches the specified pattern.
